name: design-mode
title: Design mode for prodyssey
outcome: An engineer can design a change with the plugin before writing it, and the resulting intent, ADR, and diagrams carry through to the pull request that implements it.
done_when: /prodyssey:design runs the seven stages and writes a design directory
submit mode resolves a design from the branch name and skips the cold interview
the viewer lists and renders designs alongside the PR timeline
abort_if: the challenge stage cannot be made to produce rejected options reliably, leaving every ADR with a single considered option
the architecture skill cannot be merged, leaving design mode without a corpus to reason with

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts (skills, scripts, viewer), 2 colliding ADRs, 1 boundary rule on install surface
